name: wayfinder
description: A city guide and directory of local places. Readers search in one sentence: find restaurants in New York.

color_scheme.description: Where every reader starts. Each can switch with the light/dark button.

places.description: Slugs of your place tags, separated by commas. Example: new-york,miami

directory_page.description: Address of the page that uses the All places template.

add_place_url.description: Link for the "Add a place" button. Leave empty to hide it.

signup_heading.description: Heading of the signup block. Defaults to "New places, once a week".

signup_text.description: One line under the signup heading. Defaults to the site description.

show_featured.description: Shows featured listings under the search.

show_places.description: Shows a tile for each place tag set above.

show_guides.description: Shows your latest posts that are not listings.

show_related.description: Ends each listing with more places nearby.
